stem: What can the reader conclude from the action in the third stanza?

options.label: F
options.text: Father makes flying look easy to the young bird.

options.label: G
options.text: Father wants to prove that he is better at flying than the young bird.

options.label: H
options.text: Father catches dinner for the young bird, even though he said he wouldn't.

options.label: J
options.text: Father thinks that the young bird isn't ready to fly.
